final.answer: The net change in Entergy Mississippi, Inc.'s net revenue during 2003 was an increase of $46.4 million.
final.explanation: Net change = 2003 net revenue − 2002 net revenue = 426.6 − 380.2 = 46.4 million dollars. The table shows the components: base rates +48.3 and other −1.9, which sum to the same 46.4 increase.
